text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I want to make everyone happy with my racing! Just like sumo stew does! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know! Let's invite everyone for some sumo stew! It'll be super nutritious, jam-packed with ingredients, and completely buono! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
